func _run_tests() -> void:
	# Controllo della robustezza delle classi senza interfaccia
	var q_edge := Question.new("Domanda di prova", ["Opzione 0", "Opzione 1"], 1)
	var test_sess := QuizSession.new([q_edge])

	check("edge_invalid_neg", not test_sess.submit_answer(-2), "submit_answer con indice negativo deve restituire false")
	check("edge_correct", test_sess.submit_answer(1), "submit_answer con indice corretto deve restituire true")
	test_sess.advance()
	check("edge_finished", test_sess.is_finished(), "La sessione deve risultare terminata")
	check("edge_after_finish", not test_sess.submit_answer(1), "submit_answer a sessione terminata deve restituire false")

	# Controllo dell'interfaccia quiz.tscn collegata a QuizSession
	var scene := await instantiate_scene("res://quiz.tscn")
	if not check("scene_loaded", scene != null, "La scena res://quiz.tscn deve caricarsi correttamente"):
		return

	var session_obj = get_prop(scene, "session")
	if not check("has_session", session_obj != null, "Il nodo Quiz deve possedere un'istanza valida di QuizSession nella variabile session"):
		return

	var btns_container := scene.get_node_or_null("MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/AnswersContainer")
	if not check("buttons_container", btns_container != null, "Il contenitore AnswersContainer deve essere presente"):
		return

	var btn1 := btns_container.get_node_or_null("Answer1") as Button
	if not check("btn1", btn1 != null, "Il pulsante Answer1 deve esistere"):
		return

	# La prima domanda ha indice corretto 1 ("Marte")
	await click_button(btn1)
	var session_score = get_prop(session_obj, "score")
	check("session_scored", session_score == 1, "Cliccando la risposta corretta, session.score deve salire a 1 (vale %s)" % str(session_score))
	check("btn_feedback", btn1.text.contains("[GIUSTO!]"), "Il pulsante della risposta corretta deve mostrare il testo [GIUSTO!]")

extends RefCounted

var text: String = ""
var options: Array[String] = []
var correct_index: int = 0


func _init(p_text: String = "", p_options: Array[String] = [], p_correct_index: int = 0) -> void:
	text = p_text
	options = p_options
	correct_index = p_correct_index


func is_correct(answer_index: int) -> bool:
	return answer_index == correct_index


static func from_dict(data: Dictionary) -> Question:
	var q_text: String = str(data.get("question", ""))
	var raw_options: Array = data.get("options", [])
	var q_options: Array[String] = []
	for item in raw_options:
		q_options.append(str(item))
	var q_correct: int = int(data.get("correct", 0))
	return Question.new(q_text, q_options, q_correct)
"},{"percorso":"quiz_session.gd","contenuto":"class_name QuizSession
extends RefCounted

var score: int = 0:
	set(value):
		score = maxi(0, value)

var _questions: Array[Question] = []
var _current_index: int = 0


func _init(questions: Array[Question] = []) -> void:
	_questions = questions
	_current_index = 0
	score = 0


func get_current_question() -> Question:
	if is_finished():
		return null
	return _questions[_current_index]


func get_total_questions() -> int:
	return _questions.size()


func is_finished() -> bool:
	return _current_index >= _questions.size()


func submit_answer(selected_index: int) -> bool:
	if is_finished():
		return false

	var current: Question = get_current_question()
	if current == null:
		return false

	var correct: bool = current.is_correct(selected_index)
	if correct:
		score += 1
	return correct


func advance() -> void:
	_current_index += 1
"},{"percorso":"quiz.gd","contenuto":"extends Control

const QUESTION_DURATION: float = 5.0
const FEEDBACK_DURATION: float = 1.0

var session: QuizSession
var answering_locked: bool = false

@onready var question_label: Label = $MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/QuestionLabel
@onready var time_bar: ProgressBar = $MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/TimeBar
@onready var question_timer: Timer = $QuestionTimer
@onready var feedback_timer: Timer = $FeedbackTimer

@onready var pause_menu: ColorRect = $PauseMenu
@onready var resume_button: Button = $PauseMenu/CenterContainer/VBoxContainer/ResumeButton
@onready var quit_button: Button = $PauseMenu/CenterContainer/VBoxContainer/QuitButton

@onready var answer_buttons: Array[Button] = [
	$MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/AnswersContainer/Answer0,
	$MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/AnswersContainer/Answer1,
	$MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/AnswersContainer/Answer2,
	$MarginContainer/VBoxContainer/AnswersContainer/Answer3
]


func _ready() -> void:
	QuizData.score = 0
	var loaded_questions: Array[Question] = []
	for item in QuizData.questions:
		loaded_questions.append(Question.from_dict(item))
	session = QuizSession.new(loaded_questions)

	time_bar.max_value = QUESTION_DURATION
	question_timer.timeout.connect(_on_question_timeout)
	feedback_timer.timeout.connect(_on_feedback_timeout)

	answer_buttons[0].pressed.connect(_on_answer_0_pressed)
	answer_buttons[1].pressed.connect(_on_answer_1_pressed)
	answer_buttons[2].pressed.connect(_on_answer_2_pressed)
	answer_buttons[3].pressed.connect(_on_answer_3_pressed)

	resume_button.pressed.connect(_on_resume_button_pressed)
	quit_button.pressed.connect(_on_quit_button_pressed)

	pause_menu.visible = false
	display_current_question()


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not answering_locked and not question_timer.is_stopped():
		time_bar.value = question_timer.time_left

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("pause"):
		toggle_pause()


func toggle_pause() -> void:
	var is_paused: bool = not get_tree().paused
	get_tree().paused = is_paused
	pause_menu.visible = is_paused
	if is_paused:
		resume_button.grab_focus()
	else:
		_focus_first_active_answer()


func _focus_first_active_answer() -> void:
	for btn in answer_buttons:
		if not btn.disabled:
			btn.grab_focus()
			return


func _on_resume_button_pressed() -> void:
	toggle_pause()


func _on_quit_button_pressed() -> void:
	get_tree().paused = false
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://menu.tscn")


func display_current_question() -> void:
	if session.is_finished():
		finish_quiz()
		return

	answering_locked = false
	var current: Question = session.get_current_question()
	question_label.text = current.text

	for i in range(answer_buttons.size()):
		if i < current.options.size():
			answer_buttons[i].text = current.options[i]
			answer_buttons[i].disabled = false
		else:
			answer_buttons[i].disabled = true

	time_bar.value = QUESTION_DURATION
	question_timer.start(QUESTION_DURATION)
	answer_buttons[0].grab_focus()


func _on_answer_0_pressed() -> void:
	_select_answer(0)


func _on_answer_1_pressed() -> void:
	_select_answer(1)


func _on_answer_2_pressed() -> void:
	_select_answer(2)


func _on_answer_3_pressed() -> void:
	_select_answer(3)


func _select_answer(button_index: int) -> void:
	if answering_locked:
		return
	answering_locked = true
	question_timer.stop()

	var current: Question = session.get_current_question()
	var was_correct: bool = session.submit_answer(button_index)

	if was_correct:
		answer_buttons[button_index].text += "  [GIUSTO!]"
	else:
		answer_buttons[button_index].text += "  [SBAGLIATO]"
		answer_buttons[current.correct_index].text += "  [CORRETTO]"

	for btn in answer_buttons:
		btn.disabled = true

	feedback_timer.start(FEEDBACK_DURATION)


func _on_question_timeout() -> void:
	if answering_locked:
		return
	answering_locked = true

	var current: Question = session.get_current_question()
	answer_buttons[current.correct_index].text += "  [TEMPO SCADUTO - CORRETTO]"

	for btn in answer_buttons:
		btn.disabled = true

	feedback_timer.start(FEEDBACK_DURATION)


func _on_feedback_timeout() -> void:
	session.advance()
	display_current_question()


func finish_quiz() -> void:
	QuizData.score = session.score
	if QuizData.score > QuizData.high_score:
		QuizData.high_score = QuizData.score
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://results.tscn")
"}],"spiegazione":"Ora lo script `quiz.gd` non manipola più direttamente i dizionari né tiene traccia manuale degli indici. All'avvio converte i dizionari in oggetti `Question` tramite `Question.from_dict` e avvia una nuova `QuizSession`. La verifica delle risposte e il punteggio sono delegati a `session.submit_answer(index)`, mentre il passaggio alla domanda successiva è gestito in modo pulito da `session.advance()`. Al termine della sessione il punteggio finale viene sincronizzato nell'autoload `QuizData` per la schermata dei risultati.","cambiati":["quiz.gd"],"rimossi":[]}}
